SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT T.*, N.MESSAGE TARGETTABLENAME, M.HREF, M.RESOURCEPATH FROM T_CORE_BPMN_TARGET T, (SELECT E.TABLENAME, MAX(M.HREF) HREF, MAX(M.RESOURCEPATH) RESOURCEPATH FROM T_CORE_MENU_EXT E, T_CORE_MENU M WHERE E.ID = M.ID GROUP BY E.TABLENAME) M, (SELECT M.MESSAGE, N.CODE FROM T_CORE_I18N N, T_CORE_I18N_MESSAGE M WHERE N.ID = M.I18NID AND LOWER(M.I18NCONFIGID) = #{_locale}) N WHERE T.TARGETTABLE = M.TABLENAME AND (T.TARGETTABLE + '.SERVICE_NAME') = N.CODE) T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT T.*, M.HREF FROM T_CORE_BPMN_TARGET T, (SELECT E.TABLENAME, MAX(M.HREF) HREF FROM T_CORE_MENU_EXT E, T_CORE_MENU M WHERE E.ID = M.ID GROUP BY E.TABLENAME) M WHERE T.TARGETTABLE = M.TABLENAME AND T.ID = #{id}
